cues: The ing form describes what causes the feeling; the ed form describes the person who has it.
The journey was tiring; the passengers were tired.
The film was boring; we were bored.
The result was disappointing; her parents were disappointed.
An interesting lecture; an interested listener.
A frightening noise; a frightened child.
text: Participle adjectives. The ing form describes what causes the feeling; the ed form describes the person who has it. The journey was tiring; the passengers were tired. The film was boring; we were bored. The result was disappointing; her parents were disappointed. An interesting lecture; an interested listener. A frightening noise; a frightened child.
